reason: Stipule scar is the scar left where a stipule fell off.
Stipular scar is the adjectival form of stipule scar.
This is the French term for stipule scar.
Stereid band is the exact term.
Stereid bundle is used with the same meaning.
Stereid strand is used with the same meaning.
Exact term.
Plural of pseudoperianth.
Bare 'propagule' also means a seed, a diaspore or a viviparous seedling (mangrove), which are not asexual propagules. Only 'vegetative propagule' is safe.
Vegetative propagule is an asexual propagule.
Exact term.
Anthecium is the grass floret, so this is the floret callus.
The lemma callus is the callus at the base of the floret.
Chlorophyllous cells in the sense of chlorophyllose cells belong to moss leaves. In other contexts it only means cells with chlorophyll.
Same as the singular form.
Chlorophyllose cell is the specific bryophyte term.
'Green cells' is a vague phrase. It is not the specific chlorophyllose cell type.
Exact term (orchid column).
Anther bed is a synonym of clinandrium.
Clinandrium-hood is the hood part of the clinandrium. It is close enough to map here.
Androclinium is a synonym of clinandrium.
Exact term.
'Dorsal wing' is used for many structures (seed, fruit, calyx, stem wings), not only the dorsal lamina.
Condyle is also an animal or generic joint term. Only an endocarp or fruit condyle matches the target.
'Basal membrane' is generic (cell wall, hair, anther, ovule). The target is specific to the endostome.
A lamella marginal cell is a cell on the lamella margin, not the lamella itself.
In vascular plants 'leaf lamella' means the blade. It is a phyllid lamella only in mosses.
Costal lamellae are the photosynthetic lamellae on moss costae (Polytrichaceae, Pottiaceae).
Exact term.
Node diaphragm is the same structure as the nodal diaphragm.
Vein axil means the angle between veins.
Axil of lateral veins is the leaf vein axil.
This is the French term for leaf vein axil.
Exact term (tendril-like leaf extension in palms, Gloriosa and similar).
Leaf whip is a synonym of cirrus in palms.
Plural of cirrus.
Plural of syconium.
A hypanthodium is a fig-like closed inflorescence. It is a close synonym of syconium and is accepted here.
Thecal appendage is an appendage of the anther theca.
Same meaning as thecal appendage.
An anther spur is an appendage at the base of the theca. It could in places be a connective appendage.
Basal appendage of the theca is the same structure.
Exact term.
Plural of carpopodium.
'Basal callus' is generic. It usually means the callus of a grass floret or spikelet, or a callus on other organs, and is not the carpopodium. Use a rule only for grass parts, or reject it.
A nectar spur is a floral spur.
Calcar also names spurs on other organs (bryophyte leaves, bird or animal structures). It is a floral spur only on flower parts.
French éperon also means a spur on a shoot or other organs. It is a floral spur only on flower parts.
Velum is the membrane covering the sporangium in Isoetes.
Isoetes velum is the same structure.
